title: Counteraction-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for General Capability Recovery with Domain Preservation
abstract: arXiv:2605.27115v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Domain specialization can improve LLM behavior, but often weakens the general capabilities inherited from the original model. Recent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) pipelines recover model capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories with teacher feedback, but typically assume teacher-aligned prompt coverage, requiring prompts to match the teachers' training distributions. This assumption is difficult to satisfy when the general teacher is an open-source model whose post-training data are unknown. Instead of attempting to reconstruct this hidden distribution, we study general capability recovery with readily available proxy general prompts. We identify two failure modes of vanilla MOPD in this incomplete-coverage situation: recovery-preservation counteraction from mixing conflicting recovery and preservation gradients, and weak-signal flattening from uniformly averaging samples with unequal correction demand

translated_title: 具有对抗感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏：面向领域保持下的通用能力恢复
translated_abstract: 领域特化可以改善大语言模型的行为，但往往会削弱从原始模型继承的通用能力。近期的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）流程通过教师反馈来监督学生模型生成的轨迹，从而恢复模型能力，但通常假设提示词覆盖与教师对齐，即要求提示词与教师的训练分布相匹配。当通用教师是一个后训练数据未知的开源模型时，这一假设很难满足。我们没有尝试重构这一隐藏分布，而是研究利用易于获取的代理通用提示词来实现通用能力恢复。在这种覆盖不完全的情况下，我们识别出原始MOPD的两种失败模式：恢复-保持对抗，即混合了相互冲突的恢复梯度与保持梯度所导致的问题；以及弱信号平坦化，即对修正需求不相等的样本进行均匀平均所导致的问题
tldr: 该论文针对领域特化大语言模型的通用能力恢复问题，提出一种对抗感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，在无需匹配教师训练分布的代理提示词条件下，识别并解决了恢复-保持对抗与弱信号平坦化两种失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a counteraction-aware multi-teacher on-policy distillation method that recovers general capabilities of domain-specialized LLMs using readily available proxy prompts, identifying and mitigating two failure modes: recovery-preservation counteraction and weak-signal flattening.
